Chapter 673: Chapter 10 Mysterious Black Planet (5000 words, please subscribe)_3

Lin Yuan left behind a surveillance method, primarily as a warning function.

Besides preventing other lifeforms from approaching, its most important role was to lock onto the position of the black planet.

The universe as a whole is constantly moving, and countless planets are no exception. Lin Yuan was worried that he might not pay attention for a moment and the black planet would wander off on its own.

Of course, this possibility was remote. Though planets are always in motion, true, Lin Yuan had already leased more than ten light-years of the surrounding star domain.

Given the slow speed of the black planet’s movement, it wouldn’t shift even one light-year in a million or ten million years.

….

...

Soon.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit returned to the Milky Way Main Star.

In the Star Lord’s Great Hall, Lin Yuan’s true body and the Taiyang Divine Spirit sat facing each other.

Rustle rustle.

The numerous Xuanhuang Crystals and Weapon Treasures were all handed over to his true body by the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

At the same time.

The Mysterious Gourd also landed in the hands of the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

After the ninth transit, Lin Yuan, within the shuttle worlds, made great progress in absorbing the liquid inside the Mysterious Gourd.

Yet the Taiyang Divine Spirit and the other Divine Spirits had yet to absorb the liquid within the gourd to push their Inner Worlds to the upper limit.

Over twenty years.

The size of Lin Yuan’s Inner World had expanded to 2.12 billion square miles, and the absorption of the seventh drop of purple liquid was nearly half complete.

One month later.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit’s Inner World reached its limit.

He then went to the Battlefields of Different Races, exchanging places with the Taiyin Primordial Spirit to continue the enhancement.

…

Virtual World.

In his spare time from cultivating Enlightenment, Lin Yuan would occasionally connect to the Virtual World for relaxation.

This day, as Lin Yuan was enjoying delicacies in his personal space, the Black Star Lord invited him to another personal space.

Lin Yuan chose to accept.

Soon, he arrived at a manor filled with ancient charm.

The Black Star Lord, the Lustrous Star Master, and the Skeletal Elder, along with several other Grade A Tier 10s, were chatting there.

The Black Star Lord and his acquaintances belonged to a small circle. Only Tier 10 Grade A could join, and though Lin Yuan was only Ninth Rank, it was not a big problem for him to reach Grade A Tier 10 in the future.

The Black Star Lord and the others were also happy to invite Lin Yuan.

“Hahahaha, the Galaxy Master has arrived,” the Black Star Lord greeted Lin Yuan with a smile upon his arrival.

The Black Star Lord belonged to the Black Origin Evolution Tower; the Lustrous Star Master came from another Evolution Tower, and strictly speaking, Lin Yuan should be considered part of the Xia You Evolution Tower.

However, since all were human Evolvers, there weren’t any barriers between them.

“Galaxy Master, I heard Nalan has stepped down from his position as Deputy Tower Master,” the Lustrous Star Master said with a gentle gaze directed at Lin Yuan.

Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master of the Xia You Evolution Tower, held significant influence within the Tier 10 circle of human civilization.

Mainly because Nalan, as Deputy Tower Master, was extremely powerful, ranking in the top hundred on the Different Species’ recorded list of Grade A individuals.

“Nalan has stepped down?” Lin Yuan was somewhat surprised.

He had met Nalan not long before, and the two of them had even exchanged ideas on the Understanding of Rules, particularly those related to the Rule of Time.

“Galaxy Master, you should know that once one assumes the role of Deputy Tower Master, they rarely get replaced mid-term,” said the Black Star Lord with a smile.

“What are you implying?” Lin Yuan pondered thoughtfully.

“Nalan, as Deputy Tower Master, is likely about to advance to Tier 11,” the Skeletal Elder beside him sighed, eyes reflecting envy.

The role of Deputy Tower Master in each of the Nine Great Evolution Towers was occupied by Tenth Rank Evolvers.

And once a Deputy Tower Master advanced to Tier 11, they would automatically resign, as Eleventh-Rank Evolvers had far more critical responsibilities ahead.

Such as preparing to strike for the Ultimate, or heading to oversee a Large Alien Battlefield.

Nalan still had plenty of time left in his lifespan and hadn’t made any significant mistakes.

Resigning out of nowhere as Deputy Tower Master, and the Supreme Being agreed to it?

There was essentially only the possibility of advancing to Tier 11.

“Tier 11, huh…” The Black Star Lord also let out a sigh.

As Grade A Tier 10s, they all hoped to advance to Tier 11, but while having hope was one thing, knowing precisely when to advance was another matter.

Seeing Nalan take the lead left everyone present with complex thoughts.

“Nalan has been stuck at a critical bottleneck in the Fusion Rules for many years now. How did he suddenly overcome it?” the Lustrous Star Master couldn’t help but voice.

“Who knows?” The Skeletal Elder shook his head, “Perhaps he experienced some kind of stimulus.”

“When you have time, Galaxy Master, you’ll have to ask Nalan for us, to find out what realization helped him cross that threshold,” the Lustrous Star Master looked at Lin Yuan and spoke softly.

Lin Yuan was a member of the Xia You Evolution Tower, and Nalan the Deputy Tower Master.

Their relationship was much closer than with the others.

“Alright.”

“Once I encounter Nalan, I will definitely ask,” Lin Yuan nodded. He too was curious about how Nalan had made his breakthrough.

Though he currently did not need it, listening more could do no harm.

“Speaking of which, Galaxy Master, you must be about to step into Tenth Rank as well,” the Black Star Lord suddenly inquired.

With Lin Yuan’s foundation revealed in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, opening up two billion Spatial Layers, stepping into Tenth Rank… must be just as simple as eating and drinking.

“Yes, with Galaxy Master’s aptitude, you might even step into Tier 11 before us,” the Skeletal Elder joked.

He spoke offhandedly; with everyone present as Grade A Tier 10s, it could be that any day now someone would follow Nalan’s footsteps, advancing to Tier 11 after a single session of seclusion.

Lin Yuan was still Ninth Rank, and even if he stepped into Tenth Rank, he still had a considerable journey ahead.

…

After chatting casually with the Black Star Lord and other friends for a while.

Lin Yuan disconnected from the Virtual World and resumed his cultivation of Enlightenment.

Nalan’s breakthrough gave Lin Yuan a great deal of motivation.

“The two thousandth Time Rule new model, is it a ring? A serpent ring?”

Visions of the River of Time in its entirety filled Lin Yuan’s mind. Overall, the River of Time flowed ceaselessly from the ancient past towards the distant future.

But in reality, in certain sections of the river, time appeared as a serpent ring, with the beginning and end connected.

“Does that mean, time is a closed loop, regardless of where you start, you eventually return to the same point?” Lin Yuan thought, as a torrent of insights and Spiritual Light flooded his mind.

With continuous contemplation, Lin Yuan was rapidly advancing his understanding of the Rule of Time.
